English.Char_Desc_80: Open-Source Offline Media Converter for Windows with Explorer & CLI
English.Char_Desc_250: AVI Core is an open-source offline media converter for Windows. Convert video, audio, and images locally with right-click File Explorer integration, hardware acceleration, and CLI.
English.Char_Desc_450: AVI Core is an open-source 100% offline media converter for Windows. Transcode video, extract audio, and compress images with native right-click Windows Explorer context menus and scriptable CLI. Powered by bundled FFmpeg with hardware acceleration (NVENC, QuickSync, AMF), instant stream copying (--fast), two-phase atomic write protection, and automatic raw file backup vaulting.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
AVI Core is an open-source, 100% offline media processing engine engineered for Windows 10 and 11. It provides both a powerful command-line interface (CLI) and seamless Windows File Explorer right-click context menu integration, allowing you to convert, remux, extract audio, and compress media without uploading files to third-party web services.
Key Features: - 100% Offline & Private: Zero telemetry, zero cloud uploads, infinite file size limits. - Windows File Explorer Context Menu: Convert media directly from the right-click menu with cascading submenus. - Fast Stream Copy (--fast): Instant container repackaging (e.g., MKV to MP4) without quality loss or re-encoding. - Multi-Select Spooling: Win32 Named Mutex coordination prevents process thrashing when converting multi-file batches in Explorer. - Master Asset Protection: Automatically vaults raw files into ./backup/ before converting. - Two-Phase Atomic Commits: Writes to temporary staging buffers (.tmp) with deep stream probe validation before committing. - Hardware Acceleration: Auto-negotiated NVENC, QuickSync, and AMF encoding for ultra-fast local throughput. - Standalone: Pre-configured static FFmpeg binary included. No separate Python or FFmpeg setup needed.
Supported Formats: * Video: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WebM, M4V, FLV, TS * Audio: MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A * Image: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP
